_label: PHASE 3 BATCH 3D — final eight nakshatra application records; universal, development only, practitioner review required
scope: Mula, Purva Ashadha, Uttara Ashadha, Shravana, Dhanishta, Shatabhisha, Uttara Bhadrapada and Revati.
writerRule: Only applicationClaims may reach the customer-writing model. Deities, symbols, mythology, source history, technical rulerships and excluded classical judgments remain internal trace.

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Mula is the Moon's nakshatra, one of the smaller lunar sections used to refine how the Moon's emotional qualities are expressed.
The person may bring steadiness and one-minded focus to emotionally important questions.
The mind may look beneath surface explanations in order to understand the underlying cause of a feeling or situation.
Searching for the root may become exhausting when every explanation is dismantled before the person recognizes what is already clear.
Development may involve seeking the essential cause without assuming that everything surrounding it must be discarded.

compositionRequirements: APP-MULA-ROOT-SEEKING requires at least one additional non-nakshatra chart factor in the reading.
APP-MULA-EXPLANATION-STRIPPING-TENSION must appear with APP-MULA-ROOT-WITHOUT-DESTRUCTION or another constructive admitted claim.
APP-MULA-NAKSHATRA-CONTEXT must appear before every other Mula interpretation.
prohibitedExtensions: death, ruin, destruction or loss prediction
claim that the person destroys relationships or structures
claim that suffering is required for transformation
presenting modern synthesis as classical quotation

Friendship may be approached with emotional loyalty and a desire to remain steadfast.
The person may protect an inner conviction while it is still gathering enough clarity and strength to be expressed.
Emotional momentum may return when the person reconnects with an aim that still feels genuinely worth pursuing.
Development may involve defending a meaningful conviction while remaining willing to reconsider how it should be carried forward.

Gentleness and gratitude may support emotional steadiness and constructive relationships.
The person may become deeply committed to a principle that feels larger than immediate preference or convenience.
Emotional confidence may strengthen through commitments that have been tested and sustained over time.
Development may involve remaining loyal to an important principle without confusing durability with refusal to adapt.

Learning and the careful reception of knowledge may carry emotional importance.
The mind may understand a situation by listening closely before deciding what it means.
The person may recognize meaning by connecting information gathered across different conversations, teachings or experiences.
Development may involve listening openly while retaining independent judgment about what deserves to be accepted and carried forward.

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Dhanishta is the Moon's nakshatra, one of the smaller lunar sections used to refine how the Moon's emotional qualities are expressed.
Generosity and courage may become important ways of responding when the person feels emotionally engaged.
Music or rhythm may provide the mind with a meaningful form of stimulation and expression.
The person may work effectively when individual effort can join a shared rhythm or coordinated undertaking.
Tension may arise when the person's own timing differs from the pace expected by a group or collective effort.

APP-DHANISHTA-NAKSHATRA-CONTEXT must appear before every other Dhanishta interpretation.

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Shatabhisha is the Moon's nakshatra, one of the smaller lunar sections used to refine how the Moon's emotional qualities are expressed.
The person may prefer emotional truth to be spoken plainly, even when the message requires care in its delivery.
The emotional temperament may include courage and resistance to being controlled or unnecessarily subordinated.
The mind may investigate a difficult question most effectively when it has privacy, clear limits and enough distance to examine the pattern carefully.
Development may involve preserving independence and honesty while considering how direct truth will affect the person receiving it.

compositionRequirements: APP-SHATABHISHA-DIRECT-TRUTH must appear with APP-SHATABHISHA-TRUTH-WITH-CARE or another constructive admitted claim.
APP-SHATABHISHA-PROTECTED-INVESTIGATION requires at least one additional non-nakshatra chart factor in the reading.
APP-SHATABHISHA-NAKSHATRA-CONTEXT must appear before every other Shatabhisha interpretation.
prohibitedExtensions: medical diagnosis, treatment or healing power
harshness, cruelty or antisocial character verdict
presenting modern synthesis as classical quotation

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Uttara Bhadrapada is the Moon's nakshatra, one of the smaller lunar sections used to refine how the Moon's emotional qualities are expressed.
Thoughtful or philosophical subjects may draw out articulate emotional expression.
The mind may be willing to remain with emotionally complex material rather than demanding an immediate simple answer.
Emotional steadiness may develop gradually as complicated feelings are given enough time to settle into a more coherent understanding.
Development may involve respecting emotional complexity while recognizing when reflection has become sufficient and movement can resume.

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Revati is the Moon's nakshatra, one of the smaller lunar sections used to refine how the Moon's emotional qualities are expressed.
Courage may be expressed with grace rather than force.
The person may feel emotionally engaged when offering direction or practical support that helps something vulnerable move forward safely.
Completion may carry emotional significance, particularly when the person can bring an experience to a thoughtful and humane conclusion.
Development may involve helping others move forward without assuming responsibility for carrying their entire journey.

implementationRequirements: Merge this overlay additively without modifying earlier application-claim overlays.
Route every claim exclusively from its purposes field; no nakshatra name or claim ID may be hard-coded into planner or writer logic.
Use the universal nakshatra introduction pattern, name the nakshatra once only and introduce the pada without repeating the nakshatra name.
Never send customerExcludedLayers, source history, deity assignments or technical rulerships to the writer.
Enforce every composition requirement and prohibited extension.
Log unused admitted claims as ADMITTED_NOT_USED without warning or failure.
Production must admit zero claims from this file until individual practitioner approval changes productionEligible.
Preserve conflict-restricted, synthesis-limited, outcome-restricted and textual-assignment-review statuses in ledger and trace.
